name: D'ark Gaiden
original_name: ディー・アーク 外伝
source:
Although it is branded a gaiden ("side story"), this game is actually a direct sequel to the first D'ark. The anti-hero of the previous game, the mysterious Dulldeek, has released the four Dragon Knights in order to help the Darkness to defeat the Light in the upcoming battle. After the light warrior Felnous was defeated by Dulldeek, it looked like the Light has lost...

D'ark Gaiden allows the player to play through two scenarios, one continuing the adventures of Dulldeek and the Dragon Knights (starting as the Black Dragon Knight Zarsch, one of Dulldeek's companions), the other casting Felnous as a protagonist, recovering after the battle with Dulldeek and swearing to exact revenge.

The gameplay is essentially the same as in the previous game: basic solo dungeon crawl through pseudo-3D mazes, turn-based combat against random enemies. It is now possible to cast defensive support magic. The animations in combat are improved, and there are more different textures in the dungeons. As in the first game, there is the possibility to turn random encounters off; in this game, there is an additional "MAX" option, which cranks the encounter rate up.
translation:
虽然冠以“外传”之名，本作实际上是初代《D'ark》的直接续作。前作中神秘的反英雄达尔迪克解放了四名龙骑士，协助黑暗势力在即将到来的战斗中击败光明。光之战士菲尔诺斯败在达尔迪克手下后，光明似乎已一败涂地……

《D'ark外传》提供了两条剧情供玩家体验。一条延续达尔迪克与龙骑士们的冒险，最初扮演的是达尔迪克的同伴之一，黑龙骑士扎修。另一条则以菲尔诺斯为主角，讲述他在与达尔迪克交战后逐渐恢复，并立誓复仇。

玩法基本延续前作，以单人探索伪3D迷宫为主，随机遭遇敌人，进行回合制战斗。本作新增了防御辅助魔法，战斗动画有所改进，迷宫中的纹理种类也更加丰富。与初代一样，玩家可以关闭随机遇敌。此外还新增了“MAX”选项，可大幅提高遇敌率。
